patch_description: The current program loses to the earlier vectorized soft-min gradient approach (0.70 vs 0.75) because its hill climbing is slow and gets stuck. The fix: (1) add a fast, fully vectorized soft-min gradient ascent optimizer (exact analytic gradient of a LogSumExp-smoothed minimum of all 286 triangle areas, with annealed sharpness) applied to every seed; (2) run the expensive exact hill-climb polish only on the top few candidates rather than every seed; (3) add a basin-hopping style deterministic perturbation-and-restart around the best solution, which directly attacks the local-optimum limitation. This keeps determinism (fixed seeds, fixed perturbations) while substantially improving the achieved minimum-triangle area and reducing runtime.
